description: This file defines types, functions, and constants related to secret resolution, including context creation, warning handling, secret assignment collection, and resolution application within a secret management system.

methods.name: createResolverContext
methods.description: Creates a new ResolverContext with initial empty warnings, assignments, and cache.

methods.name: pushAssignment
methods.description: Adds a SecretAssignment to the context.

methods.name: pushWarning
methods.description: Adds a warning to the context, avoiding duplicates based on warning key.

methods.name: pushInactiveSurfaceWarning
methods.description: Adds a specific warning indicating a secret ref is on an inactive surface.

methods.name: collectSecretInputAssignment
methods.description: Coerces a value into a SecretRef and, if active, pushes an assignment; otherwise, pushes an inactive surface warning.

methods.name: applyResolvedAssignments
methods.description: Applies resolved secret values to assignments, validating types and throwing errors if unresolved.

methods.name: hasOwnProperty
methods.description: Checks if a record has a specific property.

methods.name: isEnabledFlag
methods.description: Determines if a value (record) is enabled based on its 'enabled' property.

methods.name: isChannelAccountEffectivelyEnabled
methods.description: Checks if both channel and account are enabled.
